summary: KB Financial Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a board resolution to declare a quarterly cash dividend of KRW 1,143 per common share, totaling approximately KRW 405.4 billion based on 354,687,734 outstanding shares. The record date is May 8, 2026, with payment expected within one month as per Korean law. The total dividend amount may adjust due to treasury share acquisitions disclosed in a separate Form 6-K. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special-situation event such as a capital return or restructuring, as it reflects standard quarterly cash distributions with no change in corporate structure or strategy. What to watch: no event-driven angle; filing is informational.
